name: Tip of the Day
author: Raj Shimpi
description: One short tip a day about Omarchy, Hyprland windows, the terminal, tmux, Neovim and git, mixed with tips made from your own keybindings. Arrives once a day at the time you choose, catches up if the laptop was asleep, never repeats until you have seen them all, and waits while you are in a meeting. Click the notification for another tip, or add the bar widget to flip through them.

barWidget.description: Today's tip, with previous and next
